key_provisions_or_claims: MEESTAR model applied to evaluate ethical implications of the RoPHa food-assistance robot across individual, social and organizational levels.
Seven moral dimensions assessed: care, autonomy, safety, justice, privacy, participation, self-perception, graded from unobjectionable to unacceptable.
Autonomy is extremely sensitive if users cannot freely choose or refuse the robot.
Safety concerns include physical safety (e.g., choking emergency detection), data security, occupational safety and legal liability.
Proposes dyadic, extended dyadic and triadic models of use and distribution.
annotation.summary_en: Book chapter applying the MEESTAR ethics model to the German RoPHa project, a Care-O-bot 4 assistive robot supporting older people with food preparation and eating. It maps ethical concerns (autonomy, safety, privacy, justice, dignity) at individual, social and organizational levels and proposes models of use.
